model_output.verdict: A 4th grade teacher with measurable reading growth and grade-level leadership.
write_up: Your resume is strong! At Lincoln Heights, you show the class you teach, the reading growth you recorded and the teachers you lead. Your earlier work at Whitman adds family engagement to the story.
The reading growth line is the standout: it gives a district assessment measure before and after, over three years. Your certification and English Language Learner endorsement are easy to find, too.

Start by adding what you did on the positive behavior support committee. Then consider leading the Lincoln Heights bullets with the reading result. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back on its own; the competition for a particular teaching job will matter too.
